title: Fix test groups in completion_dao_extended_test.dart and completion_dao_extra_test.dart that reference the removed CompletionDao.insertCompletionsBatch method
why: completion_dao.dart's own doc comment states: 'Write methods (insertCompletion, insertCompletionsBatch) have been removed. New completions are written exclusively through CompletionWriter.' These two group() blocks (and completion_dao_extended_test.dart's file-header doc comment) still name and describe `CompletionDao.insertCompletionsBatch` as if it exists. What they actually exercise is the test-only `seedCompletionsBatch` helper (test/helpers/drift_memory.dart, itself an unbatched loop over `completionEventDao.appendEvent`) followed by CompletionDao read methods. A future maintainer reading these group names would reasonably believe CompletionDao still exposes a batch-insert API.
recommendation: Rename the groups/comments to describe what's actually under test (e.g. 'seeding + getCompletionsByTrack/ByProfile') or drop the stale 'insertCompletionsBatch' framing entirely.
acceptance_criteria: Neither file's group()/doc-comment names a CompletionDao method that doesn't exist on the class.
